hardwareHubs.note: Micron is expanding its memory manufacturing campus in Boise, anchoring a semiconductor supplier base.
The Idaho Innovation Center hosts the Factory 43 makerspace.

makerspaces.name: Albertsons Library MakerLab
makerspaces.note: Boise State lab with an Epilog laser cutter, Nomad desktop CNC, resin printer, and Arduino and Raspberry Pi kits, open to Boise State students, staff and faculty only.

makerspaces.name: Factory 43
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit community makerspace with a wood shop, machine shop, laser cutters and a 3D printer, per a 2023 opening report.

specialties.name: Semiconductors
specialties.note: Idaho Commerce lists semiconductor as a key industry and Micron is building memory fabrication capacity in Boise.

specialties.name: Food processing
specialties.note: Idaho Commerce lists food processing as a key industry.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: Idaho Commerce lists aerospace as a key industry.

specialties.name: Outdoor recreation products
specialties.note: Idaho Commerce lists outdoor recreation as a key industry.

support.name: TechHelp
support.note: Idaho manufacturing advisory organization with offices in Boise, Post Falls, Twin Falls and Pocatello, offering new product development help to inventors through its studio Blu program; its site does not itself state the MEP role.
